commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Flag goes up against Umar Sadiq (Valencia) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+3' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Umar Sadiq (Valencia) was quite harsh and Jesus Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' The ball rebounds to Jose Copete (Valencia) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
90' Andre Almeida (Valencia) will take the corner.

89' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the right side of the goal. Luiz Junior is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Valencia.
88' Substitution. Guido Rodriguez is replaced by Andre Almeida (Valencia).
86' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:6.
83' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Dani Parejo (Villarreal) replaces Santi Comesana.
83' Substitution. Nicolas Pepe did his best and is replaced by Alfonso Gonzalez (Villarreal).
82' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Luiz Junior comes off the line to clear the ball away.
80' The ball is cleared after Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

79' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Luiz Junior leaps like a salmon to deny him.
78' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) replacing Jose Gaya.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luis Rioja leaves the pitch and Hugo Duro (Valencia) comes on.
78' Thierry Correia (Valencia) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
76' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
76' The Villarreal players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
73' Luiz Junior is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Thierry Correia (Valencia). Easy save!
70' It's time for a substitution. Thierry Correia (Valencia) comes on in place of Unai Nunez.
70' The substitution is prepared. Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Filip Ugrinic.
70' Marcelino decides to make a substitution. Ayoze Perez will be replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal).
70' A substitution has been made. Alberto Moleiro is replaced by Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal).
69' The attendance for today's match is 19233.
67' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
65' Unai Nunez (Valencia) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

65' Unai Nunez (Valencia) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Villarreal earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
64' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
62' Javi Guerra (Valencia) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Luiz Junior comes off his line to intercept.
58' Pape Gueye is substituted due to injury. Marcelino gives a chance to Thomas Partey (Villarreal).
57' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
54' The corner from Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is hurriedly cleared.
54' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Villarreal.
53' Eray Comert (Valencia) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
50' The resulting corner from Luis Rioja (Valencia) is cleared.
48' Unai Nunez (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Corner kick. Valencia will have an opportunity.
47' Jose Copete (Valencia) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+11' Jesus Manzano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+9' Close! Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
45+8' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
45+6' 2 - 1 Goal! Pape Gueye (Villarreal) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Stole Dimitrievski into the bottom left corner.
45+5' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+5' It’s a PENALTY to Villarreal after the VAR review!
45+3' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Villarreal! Let's see what he decides.
45+3' It's like he was asking for a caution. Javi Guerra (Valencia) receives a yellow card.
45+2' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
45+2' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle and it's Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
44' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
44' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
42' The game is interrupted. Javi Guerra (Valencia) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
39' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) swings in a cross from the corner, but Stole Dimitrievski reads it well and gathers the ball.
38' Jesus Manzano shows a yellow card to Largie Ramazani (Valencia) for a tough tackle.
37' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
34' Luis Rioja (Valencia) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
31' 1 - 1 Goal! Santi Comesana (Villarreal) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
31' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
30' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) picks up an injury.
27' 0 - 1 Goal! Largie Ramazani (Valencia) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Luiz Junior to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
27' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) is going to take the penalty!
25' Referee Jesus Manzano awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
25' There's a break in play and referee Jesus Manzano must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Valencia using VAR. This could be interesting!
23' Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jesus Manzano didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
21' A pass from Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is intercepted by Stole Dimitrievski and the move breaks down.
18' The resulting corner from Georges Mikautadze (Villarreal) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
18' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.

16' Jose Copete (Valencia) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top right corner. His long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
16' Jose Gaya (Valencia) is about to take a corner kick.
15' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play and Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) works the corner short.
12' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is out of play and Villarreal manage to earn a corner.
11' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
9' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
8' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Stole Dimitrievski.
4' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
2' Great teamplay by Villarreal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

The players are out at last! Villarreal will take the kick-off.
